selection: for each held-out subject (sorted), for modality in (eeg, eog): np.random.default_rng(20261114) choice of 128 5-s windows without replacement from all windows of that subject, then sorted (one rng shared across subjects/modalities in this order)
t_rule: t_b = 5*b + rng.integers(0, 5) for b = 0..9 (same rng, after selection)
noise: torch.Generator(cpu).manual_seed(20261114); torch.randn((2048, 10, 1, 1000)), float32; noise[i, b] belongs to val_row i, bucket b
preprocessing: same as W3 cache: 100->200 Hz resample_poly(2,1), uV/100, official staged_mu_law; window k = samples [1000k, 1000(k+1))
mse: per (val_row, bucket): mean over 1000 samples of (v_pred - v)^2, v-prediction, DDPM 50 steps squaredcos_cap_v2; x_t = add_noise(x0, noise, t); main condition = no EEG condition, EMA weights
report: {eeg,eog}_tLO_HI = mean over that modality's rows for bucket; {eeg,eog}_all = mean over all buckets
stop_metric: mean over (eeg, eog) of mean over buckets [1, 2, 3, 4] (t in [5, 25))
